reason: A browser-side DeepSeek Harness enhancement plugin primarily focused on appearance and layout customization, with local event notifications and session file-change visualization.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供外观定制、会话事件提醒以及按轮次展示文件差异和代码对比功能。
summaries.en: Enhances the DeepSeek Harness Web interface with appearance customization, session event alerts, and grouped file-diff and code comparison views.

capabilities: customizes the web interface appearance and layout
plays local audio alerts and displays user-provided images for session events
reads session snapshot diff data to present grouped file changes and code comparisons
stores configuration and uploaded image data in browser local storage and IndexedDB
